rounds.text: Kiri Industries is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.40x [E1]. While long-term sales growth has been stagnant [E7, E8, E9, E56], the company has reached a critical inflection point with a 13% increase in trailing twelve-month sales [E10] and a 22% year-over-year sales growth [E61]. This recent momentum is further supported by profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year [E64], suggesting that the business is successfully reversing its historical trend. Conceded: [E3, E5, E6, E65]. Although the stock is currently positioned near the bottom of its 52-week range [E4], the combination of strong recent sales growth [E62] and a valuation well below book value presents a compelling case for a business that is currently being under-appreciated by the market.
